purpose: Calibration baseline for the 2005-06 game engine. A season is simulated on the environment of the last completed season, never on its own final averages.

verification.method: Read from the Basketball-Reference 2004-05 season page League Average rows (Per Game, Totals and Advanced team tables) by scripts/import_league_environment.py. Per-game values cross-checked against the Totals row; ORtg recomputed from points and pace; eFG%, FT/FGA and TOV% recomputed from the Totals row. Player-rate baselines and the team-turnover residual are added by scripts/build_season_baseline.py from the season's player totals.

sources.notes: League Average row of the Per Game Stats team table; pace and four factors from the Advanced Stats team table League Average row.

engine_assumptions.status: provisional structural assumptions, not sourced league data
engine_assumptions.note: Copied unchanged from the 2003-04 file's structure; not researched.

omitted_keys.team_turnovers_per_game: added by scripts/build_season_baseline.py from the 2004-05 player totals
omitted_keys.player_rate_baselines: added by scripts/build_season_baseline.py from the 2004-05 player totals
